title: Telikom PNG Country Roll-Out
summary: Structural design and maintenance support for Telikom PNG's nationwide mobile network upgrade — tower foundations, lattice structures, strengthening and slope stability.
body:
RNL were the leading structural engineers on the design and maintenance of Telikom PNG's nationwide mobile communication upgrade.

## Scope

- Foundation designs for new towers
- Lattice structure design and QA checks
- Foundation strengthening of existing towers
- Slope stability works at sites across PNG
